results.title: Interface language
results.checks: Account pane → Language → français; the sidebar heading changes from 'Tabs'

results.title: The translation window, grouped by language
results.checks: The translation code opens the old reader's window (Esc on its download tip closes only the tip): English first and open with BSB ticked; the filter offers Complete / All / Popular translations and Popular keeps only the popular languages; searching 'Español' shows the Spanish section; ⓘ on a row shows its licence; share copies the translation's link; a download can be cancelled part way and its button comes back; Esc closes
results.note: grouped by language with English first; filter, search, licence, share and a cancelled download all worked

results.title: Tab marks and the collapsed rail
results.checks: A bookmark on John 3 puts its ribbon on the tab's row, and Listen puts a speaker there while it plays. With the sidebar closed to its rail, the tab is the old reader's tile: 'JHN 3', the speaker, and a label that says it is playing audio
results.note: row: ribbon and speaker; rail tile 'JHN 3', 'JHN 3 — playing audio'; the speaker went with Pause

results.title: The phone's swipe shows the next chapter
results.checks: On an iPhone 13 at John 3, dragging the page to the left moves it with the finger and John 4 slides in beside it with its title and text; letting go part-way springs back to John 3, and a full swipe lands on John 4. Dragging right from John 4 shows John 3 coming in from the left
results.note: mid-drag John 4 at 248px; a short drag stayed; a full one landed on John 4; dragging right brought John 3 in at -248px

results.title: Switch language?
results.checks: Picking a Spanish Bible from the English interface asks '¿Cambiar de idioma?' in Spanish with Cambiar, No cambies and Nunca vuelvas a preguntar; No cambies keeps English and it is not asked again in that tab. In a new tab Cambiar turns the interface Spanish. Back to an English Bible it asks in English; Never Ask Again stops it for good
results.note: asked in Spanish with its three answers; No cambies kept English and it stayed quiet in that tab; Cambiar turned Spanish; back to English it asked in English; Never Ask Again stopped it
